name: Nue no Naku yo ga Akerumade
original_name: 鵺の鳴く夜が明けるまで
source:
A game adaptation of a light novel. Set at an academy,
the game involves discovering the truth behind a set of serial murders.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ264058.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一款改编自轻小说的游戏。故事以学园为舞台，
围绕揭开一系列连环杀人案的真相展开。

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ264058.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
